subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can name breakfast foods like cereal, porridge, soup and toast.
I can say what people eat for breakfast in different countries.
I can make an Omani breakfast menu.

tf.s: Breakfasts are different around the world.
tf.why: Yes! Every country has its own breakfast.

tf.s: In Japan, some people have fish, pickles, rice and soup for breakfast.
tf.why: Well done! That is a Japanese breakfast.

tf.s: In South Africa, people have corn porridge with sugar and milk.
tf.why: Great! Corn porridge is from South Africa.

tf.s: In Oman, we have Khubz Rakhal with fish and pickles.
tf.why: In Oman we have Khubz Rakhal with eggs and beans.

tf.s: In the UK, some people have toast and tea.
tf.why: Yes! Toast and tea are a UK breakfast.

tf.s: Children in the UK often have soup and rice for breakfast.
tf.why: UK children often have cereal, milk and juice.

tf.s: Khubz Rakhal is a breakfast from Japan.
A breakfast menu has food and drinks for breakfast.
tf.why: A menu shows what we can eat and drink.

tf.s: Tea is a food we eat with a spoon.
We say This is Khubz Rakhal. for one food.

boxes.q: Where do people have Khubz Rakhal?
boxes.why: Khubz Rakhal is an Omani breakfast.

boxes.q: Where do people have corn porridge with sugar and milk?
boxes.why: Corn porridge is from South Africa.

boxes.q: What do we have with Khubz Rakhal?
boxes.why: In Oman we have it with eggs and beans.

boxes.q: Where do some people have toast and tea?
boxes.why: Toast and tea are from the UK.

boxes.q: Which country has fish and rice for breakfast?
boxes.why: In Japan some people have fish and rice.

boxes.q: What is on a breakfast menu?
boxes.why: A menu lists food and drinks.

boxes.q: Which word is a breakfast food from the lesson?

mcq.q: Which foods are from a Japanese breakfast?
mcq.why: In Japan some people have fish, pickles, rice and soup.

mcq.q: What do children in the UK often have for breakfast?
mcq.why: UK children often have cereal, milk and juice.

o: Khubz Rakhal with eggs and beans
mcq.why: Khubz Rakhal is our Omani breakfast.

mcq.q: Which word is NOT a breakfast food from the lesson?
mcq.why: A board is in the classroom, not on the table.

mcq.q: Choose: In Japan, some people have fish / toast for breakfast.
Write a sentence for your Omani menu.
o: We have eggs and beans for breakfast.

mcq.q: Your friend likes porridge with sugar and milk. Which country has this breakfast?
mcq.why: Corn porridge with sugar and milk is from South Africa.

mcq.q: How is a Japanese breakfast different from an Omani breakfast?
o: Japan has fish and rice; Oman has Khubz Rakhal with eggs and beans.
Japan has Khubz Rakhal; Oman has fish.
Oman has toast; Japan has cereal.
mcq.why: Each country has different breakfast food.

mcq.q: Which menu is a good Omani breakfast menu?
o: Khubz Rakhal, eggs, beans and tea
mcq.why: These foods are from an Omani breakfast.

mcq.q: In the lesson, which two breakfasts have milk?
mcq.why: UK children have cereal and milk; South Africa has porridge with milk.
